attempts.summary: Configured OPNsense HAProxy on node1 (10.100.109.10, port 80) to load-balance across identifying HTTP servers on node2 (10.100.109.11:8080) and node3 (10.100.109.12:8080), and verified node4 receives alternating round-robin responses through that single entry point. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, proving boot-identity change and full service/LB recovery on each.
